eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Shimbu kanda ahete akwa Espanha mu seculo 16, kuwuto wa China Kwapwile kuthumina kuli Inca muze akwa araucanos anawa apwile akwa ihunda (mupuche) kathungile mu cima nhi kusango lya China.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuuches kankapua athu aze aza kakazanguile milimo iya america, aze kakataiginha ilonguesa iyo ya malime ako spanha, nhi muze ayo anaketxa Chile.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Cipue Chile kana kahandji independencia mu 1810 (mu kaci ca jita napoleonicasnguokahicikanga Espanhanhinhiumue nguvulu wamucima unakalakala mu miaka imue), kuwina cakussakula hali ma espanhois cakapuile kuwana ndo 1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Cifuci ca República Dominicana (mu Espanhol : República Dominicana) cili ca chifuchi cha caribé cize catanda cihanda cakucitokelo ca thungu ya espanhol, kuze analite pela nhi Haiti.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Kuhina ya maussanhino ya mavu atoma nhi majila ya molundu, cifuci cili cihela cindji cikulu mbongue europeia yama Americas, mussono cihanda ya Santo Domingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Alize thungu lia thuama, mukalunga haanalithungo ha cisuho citangu kuli a Taínos e Caraíbas. A caraiba te athu amwe waze ahandjika liji anavuluka ngwo Arahuaca waze ahetele mu muaka wa 10,000 a.c.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Ha myaka yikehe muze te akwa kuhengwola aku Europa aciheta, mbunga ya Tainos kana kapua lume nhi kulumbunuka akutepulula kuli uaze anakaapita akwa Espanha.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Nhi kulita nhi Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (tratado de las índias) aze wahandjikile muakachi ka miaka 1492 nhi 1498, aze ejilenhikulitanda cifuci akathukile ku Espanha, yashaha a Taìno kutena 100,000.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardin ya la Unión cihela caco capwile kutunga ngwe cambango jitatu ca wuwanhino wa kanunu XVII- kumi nhi nake, ce cikungulwila ca zuwo lya yikungo lya San Diego lye lyimuwikha lyasalyilemo.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Hapuila kuyakulinguiwa ngue katalilo muze uma muyisoloka ufuku nhi mualua.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Kuli mazua anji akulila ha mulongo wa ngalaja,nhichingoloshinhiufuko kwakuya atunhikwimba chawana puto ha katalilo wa ha muchima.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del beso ( mujila ya bejjo) masuo ali akusekulua wikha nhi 69 centiimetro ya thunda yapua chihunda chafumano wa zangi.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Mumu lia jimwe palata, uthuanuke amwe maakamabuluila hishima.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Bowen Island yma akulingako yakutela kulinga mumatangua aze muthu uze nhicecimue lia kulinga, hanga uhasse kuenda hashi nhi kulinga yuma iykowo ize wakuzanga.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Acino cihunda camwenemwene cathuama ku Howe Sound, hakamwihinhiVancouver,nhikucapwa cashi kuwana mukaci ca wendelo wamulwiji, uze wa kukathuka ku thungu ya Granville mukacika mbonge ya Vancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Kuli uaze akuzanga yuma yikuo achiela chipema anji akuenda kusesa lia kalunga luiji amualua upema.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (ha kuiya cakulinga ku Vancouver ka coalinga 1,5 kuenda nhi machinhi) machinhi kananhinguika cindji cilumbo lia athu akua kuasa akuendelamo ku matangua aku linga mualua undji... wa mu miaka wa 2010.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Mu Inverno, tala amue ahina esquiadores ya America ya Kusango, nhi mu luxiho esseka imue yaumuenemuene yamakinga ya mulundu.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Malisesa ndo kulianga kwaalakenha shimbu thanda ena ndo mwopwanhikuthusukua cimwe mba upalikishile ufuku mu luaza.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena ili chipatulo cha halutwe ku kusula cha jila ya akwa kufunga chize akuhana kulia chipema, chihela cha kupombanhimihela, La Leona, San PadrillonhiLos Patos, ayo kakuhana wika mbalaka ya kupombela.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Mucihasa kupua cashi kupwa nhi mikanda ya uzekelo wa minhau cize lume kwe kucithulilo ca Ranger ya Puerto Jiménez, alioze ayo keshi kutaiza mapapilo a mikuli.
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Milimo ya kukundjika minhau (MINAE) kuishi kuhana lisesa liakukundjika naco, lize mulilinga kakweji shimbu te ye minhau khanda iciheta.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol ca kuhiceka ihela waze mahalakenha ha US$30, chipue $10 ya fweto ya tangua limu wikha; kulumbununa ha website yo ya Corcovado.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Mbaka ja Cook jili ifuchi inalifanhiukungulwilo wa Zelandia yaha, ili ha limbo lia Polinesia, mukachi ka kalunga luis wa kuuto “kusule”.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Wundjiwathungu-mumeya yilyi nhi 15 kumi nhi yitano ya thungu já twamako hawundji wa 2,2 lya yinunu ya km2 já tulunga-lwiji.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Nhi maola amuwika ya Havai, ma ilha kali hamue kumbanguo“Havai kuze kuixi”.
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Cipwe jikehe, jakuilula amwe thushinakaji ja ku havai shimbu te khanda cipwa cifuci, shimbu khanda mucipwa mazuwo aneneanene akupombanhiakwo akwo.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Kuteleka lia mu islandia kashi kuatuamine kuma kundji kuze aku linguila kulia mas katuamako 15 utelekelo waze alisa ku kuthungu. Anene ndo Rarotonga nhi Aituaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Kuifuci ize yathathuka hamathangwa jamusono kukilikita ca mihelanhikulia ca cinene ca kusakula ca ndando indji kaanaka cithuala ndo haze khanda augo ipwe ngue kusolola ca ulangaji.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Mazuwo akupomba eswe kaakuete ykuma yali ize athu aakukaulamo: muhelanhikulia ca cinene, yenayo aakulema kuhana cahiana.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Akutuala naua mu yé hela yize yi pema yi kapue naua kulinga akauane mazalo amu hela uase andando ikalo aku tuala naua kocha ya kulinga ku moko umue muhela ukulu.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: kulia ca cimene muthuhasa kucinga ya ekemena ya mucihunda andji longa lia anfitriao.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Chihela chino muchihasa kupua ngue edificio ya yishima yikulu nhi yuma yikuo yize yikulu,chihela chize chipema chili naua nhi piscina.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Ku nguia ku maxinhe genhi muze ngunakapwa hakukatukako, ku chipendo kuli ifunda ize muikulueza hanga wende cawa.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Kuhiana iya maxinhi anene anene, yena kafalume hunaliejilila nhi kwendessa iya maxinhi iye nhi unanhinguika massulilo je.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Kutomba ca cimwe cizavu ca milyimo wa muthu handji mbonge yimwe muyihasa kuneha manyonga amwe kalyitele.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: kuunyongonweno, mana a kwenda wenhi mu mashini je kali apema, mba chikalu chinji muli yena kujika mbalaka.
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Hiko cicalo culanda machinhi uli nhi minivan Suv, munene sedan timue station wagon nhi kali cifamo wa kupomba.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Mazuwo akwo a wenhi kalinhichimwe chihingo cha mashimbo a oru a mujila ya kumboy wa kukakumuka mwishinhindeke; shimbo lia jita yamuchali mu yifuchi yeswe ha miakulula ya miaka ya seculo 19 hanji uputukilo wa seculo 20.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: awa mazuwo pomba kulya kapwile kuze te phici nhi akwa lufuma akwa apwile nhi kutwama, mashimbu amwe kapwile nhi kulya cipema nhi ufuku upema.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Nhi acessorios antiquados, akuhona cha atu uaze mutumona nhi kulitesa nhikuhonga gracioso ena há akulinga nhi mutapu ho.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Cipue kali cizecene mazuwo ambala, matangua amue kakukwasa makulwana ama cifuci ngueji nhi akwo nawa.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Wumwe mukwa wungeji nhi wambongo jindji mahasa kutayiza yimwe ndeke yize muyijinga cifuci, yapwa kukinda wupombo muyihela yindji ya zuwo-pombakulya.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Imue rede iya intercambio iya uhwimino ili ululikonguoiyanungu akwa kwenda wenhinhiakwa kutwama ihela mu mambonguenguomaiyanhikumeneka.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Kundjila ku milimo ya mutaphuao muihassa kuinhisa nhi kupua nhi mukanda imuika ku online, ku milimo iyesue malinga.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Wumwe mulongo wa enyacihunda wulyiko wuze wakuneha mumulalyi wasona já makina handji kanalyivu mashimbu amwe mewuluka mikanda nhi mayihilukila kulyi akwawungeji.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Milimo iya Couchsurfingkaiputukile mu kutano iya 2004, muze pogramador informatico Casey Fenton unakawana ndeke nhi ndando inaxiwa inayi ku Islandia mbate muxi cihela hanga atfame.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Katuma imue e-mail kuli akwa kulilonguessa acihela cizenhikutambula cimue kwalula cinene iya kuhana iya kukwassa cawana.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Mazuwo akukwassa waze kexi nhi mazuwo kakutela camba camba akweze-umue convidado wahaze hene uli kuli makumi ali nhi ndambu ya miaka-handji nawa haze mahassa kuwanaho cindji cindji akwa kwenda wenhi makuluana.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Assoko ali nhi tanuke kali nhi kutala ceka, mba amue keshi nhi ma zuwo kakwecela mu mahondo iya mutu imuwika.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Ku lupango lia benjing kue mapua kuashila ku miaka ya 2022, mapua lupango mutango kuze mashila ku matangua a mualua.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing mu mupwa cifuci lia kuazuluilamo nhi ku kanga, milimo iya miaso kuhangana nhi iyuma iko nawa.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Ilika ikwo ya esqui muyikapwa kulingila mu cihela ca esqui ku Taizicheng ku zhangiikau, catwaku thando yalita nhi 220 (140 milhas) km nhi kuheta ku Pequim.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Matembele andji kaakwete iwanhino ya hamwaka ize yakuputhuka mukutathu ndo mu kaci ka kuvwa, ize ya kwalumwokanhikulitanhikualula ca tembelenhitembele.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Yuma yesue acuzanga culiga ya festa kakuiylinga nhi kunez apresinte ou mutu muko.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Yilyika ya matembele a Kerala yakupwa yipema cindji ha kuyitala, nhi kushindakenya yeswe ha kutala ndjamba yifathulo, yingambangamba mutembele nhi yilyika yikwo.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Chimue chihela cha mavungu esue (anachisanika nguo chilueza chamavungu china lumbunuka expo) china pu chinene bonane yamavungo esuenhiyi heho yamalinjekela.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Kulonguessa lia ihunda iko iakusopha milonga iya kuzekuene ikulo nhi iyaha lia ku cifuci.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Exposiçcoes Horticolas internacionais yili maheho yakutala tala akusolola exposicoes florais, jardins botanicos nhi yuma yikuo yize yina tala ku mitondo.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Chipue kumana jo mahasa kupua nhi chihela a muaka (ngue chize mutu masa ku uana muchifuchi chize chinalituchika) akulinga ka chipue muihasa.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Milimo yo ya ku tuama matangua asambano, kakupua ku ilinga nhi 50 hecters.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Kwathwama iphimo yekanhiyekha ya izulie ya lihandvununa ize apwilenhikusasako muaya miaka ce cizulie kaputhu cize capuile nhi iphimo 35mm i (cize 36 ndo 24mm yayizulye) ye yalemako.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Mahassa kupwako caushi, nhi wahonga kaushi, mahassa ku ringa milimo kawa kaushi mahassa kupua ngue DSLR.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Yimwe shipeyi-cizazulye ca muya-wayizulye wa mulalyi wukehe kakulyinga 6 nhi 6 cm tuyiphindji mba cakupwa kulyinganhi nhi cizulyecila ca 56 nhi 56 mm cawusuhe.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Ai iyakuhana cimue ciyulo ngue matangua awana cinahiana iya imue cipi iya 35 mm (3136 mm2 ha 864).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Mwono wa kwendangana nwge tushitu wulyi nhi wulemu há mwono wa mukwa kuciza yizulye, catamba kutesa hakuyuka, wushishiminye, wunhingiko handji yingambangamba yipema.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Fotografia iya muono mumussengue ili matangua andji kutambula ngue iyaumuenemuene, mba cize ngue izulya muessue, chimwe chizulya inatela kuhiana tununu maliji.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Fotografia ya muono wamussaki yatela handji amue mawana telebjectva issuku, hamue yuma ngue imue mbunga ya tujila handji imue kulela ikehe ikehe inatale mawana ako.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Undji watuxitu ahaze kali akalu ya kwawana, nhi mu parques kuli andji regras haku ciza fotografias ha ningosso.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Cifuci amu iyambo ola iko katuama nhi taci ola iko katuamine nhi taci. Tangua mulihasa kupua liaussu ou liomu.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Mavungo kalinaua akutuala chamalimi 5000 yamalimi ali tuchika, mbanaua makumi aali nhi 50 milhoes je já ku hanjika.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Ma liji assoneka kali cindji axi iya kwiva kuhiana ma liji ahandjika, cinonguocili caumuenemuene mu cilumbu iya itwama,nguokali matangua andji akalu iya kuhandjika iyakwivakanawa.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Mui ifuci yesue ya mundho kali akw kuhandika Ingles handi nawa mahasa kumanhina unhinguikiso kumanhisa-cambacamba akueze.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Nhongo nhi unazangue, umue Mancuniaco, Bostoniano, Jamaicano nhi Sydneysider kanatuama wa ulio kanalila mu zuo lia kulandjisaa kulia mu Toronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Ayo kali anassehenhiiximo iya mbongue iyo natais, anambulula mu malimi jo analissenhiargot iya cihela cize.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Kulandila kula mu ipatulo ya kulandishila kulya, chili kupwa cha kukokolola ndando ya kulia.nhikakushi uhashi wa kusakula, kusakula chakupwa cha kutondekeza wika ku kulia chakuteleka kulu.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Shimbunhishimbu mawenda waze anene kaanatambula cisuho cakwalumiona ca kulia cize hicinahi hanga athu alie, amwe maahana cimwe cingungu ca kujika cakahia ka zambwe cakuvumishi na kulia.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Ku ifuci imue handji mazuwo akulandjisa kwatuma limue zuwo ya kulandjisa kulia mu cihela caco, limue lia kulandjisa kulia nhindando yashi.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Linga umbate mucanda wa chipatulo cha kufumbanhishimbi ja mwono we.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Ndo mussolola imue endereço electronico ya seguradora nhi kwalula ya telefone yamu cifuci ca haze ha malonguesso/nhikwecela nhi kussolola ya kuhangulula.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Puakonhicopia iko mu bagagem iyenhionline (e-mail hali iyenanhianexo, handji iyakuttulika mu “masselwa”).
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Nhi unambe kuiya nhi laptop ou tablet ndo mupua nhi italikiso giko ya utulikilo (hiko cikalo internet).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Ni nawa twakuhana ma pepa ha chiyulo cha chizavo kuli waze masepa a wenhi isemuka oo masepa waza alinhimbunge ya kutá.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Ma alces (nawa ananhinguika ngue alces) kexi kulinunga nhitaci jindji,mba kakulilamuina nhi umue upi.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Muze atu matala mbaunhikalengulula, chikalu kuningika upi wenhi.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Kunua hakehe hakehe walua. Walua wakuzenguessa muthu nhi muthu, ndo unhinguke isulilo iye.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Milimo ya akwa ku uka ya matangua andji cilumbu ca kunwa cindji ya walwa muihassa kucinga kupihissa mu liai nhi ndo kuhona ca messo nhi kufa. Upi unakolo muze manwa walwa wakulinga ayo ene.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Ma destilados ilegais mahassa kupuanhiupi undji iyaupi, kucinga metanol,nguomahassa kuneha kula ca messo handji ufe, cipue ha ukehe doses.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Aji ji oculo mujasa kufika yandando yashi muchifuchi cha haze,akutuala ayifuchi yize yatuamine kanaua kuze milimo yakufika ndando yikehe.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Nhonga kulinga imue exame wa ku meso ku zuwo, cambacamba nhi kuli kanawakufuka, nhi kunehia mukanda hanga a utulike mu cihela cekha.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Ma molduras, wa yuma top wa gama ili ha ihela haze muihasa kupwa nhi milonga jali; imue muihasa kupwa Knock-offs,nhi au mwenemwene iya kwiza kuno muihasa kupwa nhi ikalo cindji kuihana ku zuwo.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Café kali nhi ulemu unene uandando mu yifuchi yesue,kanaitesa nguo maiuana mumilali yinji ya regiao de origem.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Ha cino, kwacama yuma indji ya lisa ya ku nwina cafe mu ifuci yessuenguocinatela kwesseka.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Canionagem (handji: canionismo) cili kuya kuiji iya umue canin,nguohandji kali womo handji iyato iya meia.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Canyoning kakucinga ihanda iya kuhala, kuninanhikutumbuka, mba cinatela relativamente treino ikehe handji forma pyschal hanga uputuke (mu kwessekanhikunina mu mawe, kajiwa handji esqui alpino, hakwesseka).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Ma kwenda kali imwe milimo cihela ca waxi iya kupwa kwendela ha ilingui iya Zambi, maximbo andji mu majila andji.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: ma jila anene mahassa kuenda tangua limuwika.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Kuenda hashi hiko cikalo, yena munhinguka kuliga yuma hakehe akehe.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Asoko waze alyi nhi twanuke akehe-akehe ndo mapwa nhi wulumbunuko wukwo, mba tangwa lyikwo ndo muyipalyikila mumwalwa cipwe apwe nhi mwana khemnba handji twanuke alyi nhi myaka ya shikwola.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Mu ifuci ya haze, mutwama ngue 200 milimo ya akwa kwenda wenhi yakululika. Andji jayo kakukalakala kexi kumanhina nhiumue.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Muhato ya Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours networks makumi ya akwakukwassa ya sightrunning ya iwana ifuci.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Nhi miji RunningTours de Barcelona Running Copenhagen ya copenhaga,hiye yaya nhi fujifuji yali chinga nhi Running Tours Praga, yize yinalijinga nhi praga nhi yikuo.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Yuma indji inatela ku imbata kanawa kunhima nhi muze muenda wenhi ku cihela cimwe.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Muze twakwenda wenhi twakushimbwila ngwenhi yuma kanda ikapwa “ngwe ya kuzowo”. Kulitanhiyako, shimbi, kulya, malimi, unji wa atu mu matapalo, mazwo a wanhinhiinji ikwo, muchipwa chinalisa.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Ai ili yumanguoyena cinatela kupua nayo nyhindu mu manhonga, hanga ukinde iyambisso handji itela iyakulinga handji ihela iya kulinga yuma.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Ipatulo ya kandonga wa wenhi, hanayitunga puto miakulula lia miaka ya seculo 19. Chipatulo cha kandonga wa wenhi chili kusakula chupema kuli waze menda wenhi kuhiana wenyembo,nhibonge, limi hanji ifuchi ya lamba.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Cipue iya undji iya agencias kanazangue kutambula undji iya utulikiko matangua essue, andji agentes kali especializados ku kulifa especificos iya mawenhi, mifunda iya orcamento handji umanhixino.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Mucihasa kupwa cashi kusa wumwe muthu yoze mashimbu eswe neye kakulyinga wenhi walyifwa.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Tala ma wenhinguokapokolo kana wezela, cipue mu website handji mumue montra iya imue loja.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Nhi unazanga nhi kutala cifuci txashi, txa kuzanga lia iyena muene, kuatuama amue mana akulinga iyuma aiye.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Aliose oo kaakulitesa ha mihimo yaali: kukilikita shimbu uli muumgegi, handji kutepulula kuphukaphuka ce. Agino shimbi jilinhi ujikijilo hacikuma ca mucali.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Kuli waze maataiza kuhicika mihela ipema, shimbunhiluthue lipema, hanga atepulule kuphuka ndo muishi citangu hulanhiungeji we cingahi muufica hakutepulula.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Malonguesso kanalwezenguoakwa kwenda wenhi kanda akeia, kupulunguza, akandjile mu itanda hi yaumuenemue ko, akapingue, handji akatambule ca mukwo yuma ya athu ako ikapue hiyo.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Umue checkpoit ya akua kuia ku ifuci iko kakumana kamuika ha ku nhina ku ndeke, andji maxinhi andji ikungo ikwo.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Ha maximbombo amue transfronteiricos, mautalilo kakwalinga nhi maximbombo inende nhi muihassa kupua nhi iye umue mukanda unacilumbunuka haku katuka hamue maximbombo awa.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Um comboio ua ufuka uaze mikanda anasanhika nguo passaporte muyihasa kuyi tambula kuli yoze mukuakuendesa achine tulo kumukuika.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Nhi unambe kuiya ku cifuci cokou ndo mupua nhi mikanda inakumbana, ku ifuci ako ndo yena muene mupoho hanga uhane mikanda iyesue ise muiya naiyo kuli masualale.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Aco mucimuzangisa kusoneka umwe mukanda kuli shipayi a mbonge hanji umwe mukwa kumeneka wa mulimo wa akwa wenhi.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Mu ifuchi injinhije shimbi jacho, mazwo akutuamina makalinga mikanda acho (kanda ukavulamanhikuhula).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Hacuma cikwo, ndo waze wikha asalanga haze kapwile kusa kuzuwo lyawungejiwatundaka ndo kaatela kwasoneka. Hacoco, mucipwisa shimbi yamokomoko, kashikha ndo nusolole washiwashi.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: General John Cadwalder makwonga imue ataque iya ku heha hali guarnição Britanica ha Bordentown, hanga akaike esue awo akwa ku kwasa.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Mazuwo andji kali apema cindji iya ca kumonanhihamesso iya limue zuwo lissuku handji iya imue lipito kanawa lume muihassa kupua umue upema hanga amone.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Arquitectura iyakulissa kutwala lume hali ako campos, kucinga planeamento iyacihunda, engenharia civil, artes decorativas, design iya itangunhiupeme.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Kuhana cize kussuku kali andji iya pueblos, kexi kapua aumuenemuene iya kuwana umue undji unalumbunuka iya muono waufuku nikha kwenda wenhi ku Albuquerque handji Santa Fe.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Hacino ngue Casino esue ali kuilo ya mikanda kakulandjissa walua, mba andji ayo kakunehia cisseke (cambacamba a waze anene ananji nguluka Abulquerque nhi Santa Fe).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Kanyama: Ngado ja muyihunda ikepe muno, hi ihelako ipema ya tamba kunjila umwe ngeji wa haze.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Kussali liko, kusango iya mwaha Mexico kalinhimilonga inalumbunukanhikwendessanhiuzengui,nhikulilulika iya akwa kwendessa anazenguewa cindji hakamwihi iya bares iya mambongue akehe akehe.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Muraisnhirabiscos keshi kuzanga kali uakunhingika ngue graffiti.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Cipue kali kussuko ya kpua umue fenomeno hamussono, athu andji kanamucingui ku kupihissa ya mazuwo ambunga nhi ambula ya akweze kuzala tinta spray.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Hacoco, mashimbu a musono kulyi akwa wuthothombo há kulyinga yizulye hunapu kusa, yilyika yawunhingikiso wakusa yiphanga “yakutayiza” kusoneka yizulye ya sona yinalyite nhi yilyinga ya wuthothombo kanda kupwa kusa yinhingi ya mahuza.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Kukonga cha bumerangues yali mana ambunga ngue anji turista anazange kukuata.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Nhi unazanga kulilonguessa kanawa boomerang yea ndo munhinguika kupua nhi boomerang ipema hanga afune ku mokoje.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: We undji wa abumerange waze anasuila mu Australia kaanapu waze keshi kahiluka. Aco shinoho hanga akwa kuliphuphula acine kweseka kukonganhifuji.
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Aze anasanhika ngwo Hangi Mealnhimaivumba mu uto.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Shima malivumisanhiliwe lizelinasasaminhanhikahia kuihela ikwonhicivukuminha ca mwala muci nenha kusasaminha hailela kuheshi kahia.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Wa hanji kakuimuizala ku hika kulia wa ufuku wa ku kutcha.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Ihunda indji kakuhana hangi iya kahia hangi giko mahasa kugilueza ku zuo lia zambi welling nhi ku ihunda iko.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: Metrorail kali nhi kombio ili mucima nhi mukaci lia ku Cabo: metroplus.
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus ili ipema cindji nhi kuzala cikehe mba ndambu wika mba ikalo, cipue nhihindu inaxiwa yanguomikanda yaxi ya metro um Europa.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Comboio muesue kali nhi metroplus ngue akutuala ku kalela ua metro. A tulela a metroplus kali kusongo lia comboio akamuihi ya mbonge ya cabo.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Muze muthucila akwenu hanga ukavulame mixete ye, ciahiana cindjinhinunatangunuka ndjiza ja ifuci yaulambala.
eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Muuhasa kukasumuka hanakutenga chimbula cha kututa kaponda “makanya asasu”, chako muchihasanhikukukokela milonga inji.
eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Ai inacingui kuximbwila mu fila, imue tanguanguotuwa farejadores iya drogas mahassa kwazala ha maximbu essuwo sem kunhinguikissa.
eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Ku ifuci iko cakulinga yuma nhi mapulica amumbogue, tximue aze akukuata camuika, mahassa culiga 10 miaka muma muakukanga. Ndo hakufa txenhi.
eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Sakunhikaasolo kujifunga mujihasa kukoka saloya kujiyanhinawa mujineha kukanhamisa kuli waze afunga cifuci waze aakuvuila woma kucikimisa ca matenda zundvu.
eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Ku zuo cilumbo cilumbo lia kusoloka cinze lia tucithu mahassa cupua nhi ikola kaushi.
eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Aliose kuihela ikwo iacifuci kuze kuathuama misenge ya thuthuthu andji cakupwa caha Kuly yenhicashi kupwanhimatata.
eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Nawa, ku climas jassassaminha cindji, twututu kakukola fuji fujinhikutwama maximbu andji haze lia mujimba.
eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Mba naua,ayitalingiso ya mujimo ya Deli,akushinga cha Farao,kuliasa cha Montezuma nhi masepa jenhi anji.
eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Cino ngue milonga ya kuhima ku maximbo akekhema cindji milonga wa mu jimo ku maximbo iya kavumi kali andji mba akunhonga akwo kali anasoloka ku pihisa nhi keshi nhi aupi.
eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Nhi uaya muze muchifuchi chipema akutuala atangua litango anji asali likuo lia mavungu kanda ulinga katonde choque cultural ya ulemu.
eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Akutuala kuli uenhi uamuchifuchi chize chinatatuka,haze anji akehe kulitesa nhi cultura mahasa Tunamono ngeji anji estaveis mahasa kuya nhi kutangunuka akumona yuma yize yaha kuezelako nhi fujifuji.
eng_text: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Amatangua jienhi uaze apema, kakutaiza ma esbajamento kuli hoteis ya estilo ocidental yize ya mulali upema, yakulia nhi milimo anga ahase kukuasa akutuala a climata-lo.
eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Aku china kupomba colchao nhi almofada nhi ashi aze yena uanhinkine nhi fauna ya chilela.
eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Ny mwoya mumusumba, mbata caló cipwe usalili mba ukinde manoka, thuvuandanhiitoji akwo.
eng_text: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Encha zuwo lieni nhi umue cafe pici ha cimene nhi umue uhumino cha iya camomila ha ufuku.
eng_text: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Muze tuli mu mashimbu a kutuaminina, kuli mashimbo akwo a kulitalata mwono we,nhikulujeka a mwe mashimo a kulinga chimwe chuma chipema.
eng_text: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Ny unalivu ngwe nguli mukwa kuliselaho zuka whashi umwe mwemo cipwe ucinge Smoothies.
eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Haji kumakawana umwe hwalua upema uze maluliekezela kulia cha chimene, muze mafunina chako chenhi cha ha tangwanhitangwa.
eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Nhi watwama muyimwe mbonge muze mulyi cako cakunwa walwa wundji, yako kuzuwo akulyila handji pubs kucihunda cize kushi kwendela.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Hali yoze kaso kunhinguika jargao medico, maliji infecciosas nhi contagiosas kali nhi ilumbukino walisa.
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Imue ikola wakulipalikissa ili azenguoili iyakuneha kuli umue katutu patogenico, ngue imue virus, umue katutu, umue fungo, handji ako parasitas.
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Imue ikola yakulipalikissa ili imue ikolanguoili yaxi yakulitutulwila mumu una lissulanga nhi muthu ulinayo.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Andji manguvulu kanazanganguonguejinguoakundjila, handji atwamamonguoakutuhuka, muma ifuci iyo hanga avacinale cilumbu imue undji iya ikola.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Mikanda yatxo ndo muilinguila cifuci cize unambe nhi kutuama.
eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Yuma ikwo ka kupema ku cifuci wa Charlotte, Carolina wa kusango, kali nhi yuma indji mupema wa assoko.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: akwa ihunda ikwo kakwambojola cize ayo atwama nhi asokoji ili itanga ilemu kashikha ayo kanazange kutwutwulukilako,mba akwa kumeneka kananyongo mashimbu eswe ku mbunge ize hanga akapwe nhi kuneha nhi twanuke akuze.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Ha miaka 20 yapalika kwoka ca kusakula masepha ja thuanuke ku Uptown Charlotte kucinasokolocanhitambu lindji, hakukamuna ca liso.
eng_text: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Ma maxinhi kexi cindji kwazala kuli assoko mu Charlotte, cipue mahassa kupua iya uzalo ulemo mu ilinga imue.
eng_text: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Nhi umue mambata athu 2, ndo mafeta mukhaso mumu jila aco yikalu cindji.
eng_text: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antarctica ili chihela cha chishika chinji hano hashi lia mavu,nhinawa inajingilika limbo lia kuuto “sule”.
eng_text: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Mawenhi akwa kuya nhi kunhinguika ifuci ili ikalo cindji, ndo mupua nhi taci mu mujimba, mba muihassa kupua nhi cihela mu luxiho ya kutatu kusambano, mba kali nhi ihanda ikwo ha ha Peninsula, mailha nhi kalunga Luiji ya Ross.
eng_text: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Cimue cihanda iya kanunu nhi kanunu iya akwakukalakala katwama hano mu luxiho mu kutwala iya kawana kumi yali iya bases, cihanda cinene cayo mu ihela ai; umue ukehe kwalula kakutwama maximbu a cixika.
eng_text: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Antarictida Yamucima ili imue planalto yawika yakufuka kuli 2-3 km ya gelo.
eng_text: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Yisuho yindji, aze ahasa kakuia mucima hanga anhine ku milundu.
eng_text: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Cawu ca Pólo Sul (tapalo lyinene), lyilyi wendelo wulyi nhi 1600 km lya thando lyatwama McMurdo ku´kalunga-lwiji wa Ross ndo ku´pólo.
eng_text: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Ciwe cakutathula haze halimena waze anajikimapandelo. Uikha a maahasa kwendelamo thuthumba waze analitela aakuthua trenós, gize anambacila mazutonhikulia.
eng_text: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Awa mahasa kupwa nhi mbuxi jindji, handjinguojila ndo mui hana cimue cijingululo cisuko ha milundhoTransantarias hanga ahete ku planalto.
eng_text: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Aize ya kutolonguesa minhau shimbu iesue ha vula matapalo asenena, mumasesanhimumashikata.
eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Cizecene wakussenena ku vula, cizecene kali maliato (mbota) kaku holoka nhi uendenajo.
eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Cikota ndo mucipwa chakujimika thando jikehe jitanonhikulita chihanda ccha 5mm (1/5 inch) cipwe kuhianhisa,nhiha cikuacilo cize cinovula cindji, haze hanathuthuminha.
eng_text: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Mbota jimwe jikwetw ndando yakuwezelanhiikwathuama imwe yakuzala ize aakuwezeloho hanga akazala kucina kusenena, ize haanaiseko ku mbotanhisaphato; jize já kukashijino handji thuzondo.
eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Kuthumbuka ndo mucipwa cihi nawa ca thando jazazuluka, mavu, mawe ausasalanhimungwa kaakuihindjila isuho indji mumatapalonhimumajila hanga ikinde kusenena.
eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Ma avalanches kexi amue axi axi; uhengue akutopeka wika mahassa kwecela cindji hakehe hakehe,nhima volumes andji makaholoka ngue avalanches.
eng_text: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Mulonga uko bundu je ja culikuata, ndo muthu muko hanga ahasse kugicekulula, hanga gissunuke, nhi umuika wariceculula bundu giko nhi neie mugilicekulula.
eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Mashumbu amwe cilyika cinapalyikako camwenemwene cilyi ca tangwa lyilyi nhi mwalwa wundji wunasasaminhisa maselwa, shimbu yimwe maselwa kanassamimya, yilyika yikwo yilyi wupwa wa tangwa, cikwo nawa cilyi ca athu.
eng_text: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Imue tornado ili imue nhima yalijingulula ya fuji ya ikehe kuixi pressão,nguoyakukoka fuji inalijingui mu cima nhi helo.
eng_text: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Kulijingajinga ca thukundwukundwu akuheta mu ciphimo ca kuheta 100-200 mu wola mu itamba kuzundwula yuma ilemu mwilu, nhi ku ithuthulwola nhi ku itwala kwekha.
eng_text: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Maputuka ngue funis nhiku palumuka cha maluela uaze akangonga maputuka naua ngue –tornados- nhi akuata amavu.
eng_text: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Akua jila yo ene yalinga kanawa ha kukondoloka manhingu nhingu a malindjekela nhy ku hunana kanawa yikuma ya mingosso.
eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Ayo kali anene cindji hali web proxies ha itela indji: ayo kakulumbula trafego yessue iya internet, kha wikako http.
eng_text: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Ayo kaakuhana shimbunhishimbu, milimo ya shinohonhiyakangana kuhiana. Ayo kuyapwa ya kujika keshica ikalu kuinonoka.
eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Ipatulo ya jila ja fuji inatwaminina há shimba jino,nhikushishika ngwenhi “kwkwika wiji”.
eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Chocho akutuala ku shimbi ja mbonge kushinhichimue kulitesa chakutuala kupia ishi kulita, kopia imouika bit a bit ya umue disco muyikemba kanaua ku chuma chesue che chuma chipema muchikalingiua.
eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Umwenemwenen uli ku hana ku milimo hanga ayo ene atale itanda yo, hanga hanga afungue falanga.
eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Yisanhiko ya muyihondo yakupwa kutwala nhi indelenet, kuyici kufupha wumwe mulyimo wa cizavu ca yihondoyafuji yilyi mucihela kuze akuya wenhi.
eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Nhimwene kukwatwamine ciphimo cize mukwacila kwalula ca haze ha mbumga wathuama, ena muhasa kulinunga nhi maliji amuisaji mukaci ka ithavi ya maliji kuixi ngoji mumusengue wa Frango; ku Alaska Sakula kwalula cize mucikutondekeza ngwo uli munonga ya Arizona.
eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Shimbunhishimbu cinakutambe kulanda kwalula cize ca kutakanhisa kweswe, cakuhandvununa, cize mucikwasa ithavi PSTN, ithume maliji kuly yena. Mumu kuze kunakathuka kwalula caco kwe muhasa kumwena kulihandununanhikukunhigika kuli athu waze maakuhandjikisa.
eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Milalyi ya walumuno wa yiphama hamashimbu akehe yize muyipwa nhi wunhingiko wa wulumbununo wakulyalumunawene yiphindji yeswe ya yiphama ya lyimwe lyimi kulyimi lyikwo.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Imue aplicaçoes iya categoria muihasa kulumbununa mikanda mu malimi ja ifuci ya haze hacilai handji yuma ikwo nawa mu cifuci ca imwenemwene muze mu kwakwizala menhika telofe ha yuma ai.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Milalyi yilyi nhi mulyimo wa wulumbununo ya malyimi yapwa nhi yithalyingiso, mashimbu amwe kanalumbununa kanawa (cikehe cindji gobberish), mba halyimuka, cipwe coco handji mahona kulyinga yuma yikwo.
eng_text: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Jila ize eswe aakuzuka mba asoneke cino cize anambe ngwo Google translate, ize aakulumbununanayo maliji amwe kwaathuala mumaliji akwo muze haazulula kuliyoze inazange.
eng_text: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Mulali wa chitavi cha jila ya fuji atambika ngwenhi GPC, kumuuhasanhikupwa mutapu wa kukukwasa muze uli kanjiza mu chifuchi cheka.
eng_text: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Aye mahasa kuphunga mbongonhikulandalanda indjikiso yaha ya GPS cipwe ce cikungo ca GPS calithuamina handji akukongola cimwe kuze aakukonguesa mawendelo.
eng_text: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Ny kutala iphusu ya kutalanayo izulie kuishimo mucisagi ce camaliji cipwe muze mucipwa kusuku kukilikita cayo mucipwa cikalu hamwe lume kushi kukilikita.
eng_text: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Loja lisswayo ili ha mbango ili iyato iya imue undji wamatatamisso iya mikanda telefonicas pre-pagosnguomaihassa ku izala kuputukila iya telefones jambunga handji telefones jesswajo.
eng_text: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Cipue mikanda yesue muyipua yipema nhi kuhanjika, welo amue kakusanhika mbunga yamucifuci.
eng_text: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Akutua kumilimo yino aunji ua hisuho kutuala yimue sona ya telefone yize keshi kuifetela muyihasa kuyi ligala aunji ua telefone jesue chakuhona kupua nhi ndando.
eng_text: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Ma regras anai ku fotografia iyatangua nawa ka kwassa ha gravacao iya videos, ngue nawa nihindu cindji.
eng_text: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Nhi katayijile kuciza nhi cimwe cicapa cayizulye, hacoco kanda tunyonga kuciza yikwo handji kupandjikanhicihondo.
eng_text: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Nhi wapua haku kuata dlone ndo mutala cindji kunhima, ize inatela ku linga.
eng_text: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Kwendanhindeke hamwenhichipalo oo handi helo lia mazwo, manyonga api.
eng_text: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Matangua amussono, mawenhi a ndeke wika akalu kali kwatulikila hazehene ha mbuga ya ndeke muze kandaucifupa nhi kulanda ndando.
eng_text: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Shimbu imwe, ndeke yoyene muihasa kufica ndando ja lisa, kwufucilo wekhanhiwekha, mba mucipwa mulipwa kuphacikila fumbulo liaconhikuhunana majila a we uthumino wa ye ndeke shimbu khanda ucithuma kuthulika ye pasashi.
eng_text: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Cipue capuile ngwe ca ulemu imwe visto ya wenhi wihi mu ifuci imue handji nhi kunhinguika nhi kulinga ningosso, handji nhi kulilonguessa mu ifuci yeka catela kupua nhi cimue cihela cize muhassa kutuma matangua andji ku hiana kuia nhi kunhinguika wika.
eng_text: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Nhi unambe kutuama mucifuci txambala ndo mupua nhe mikanda.
eng_text: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Wutayizo wa yicapa ya akwakulyilongesela haze lya cifuci yikwete shimbi jaco kuyalyifile nhi shimbi jikwo já akwa wungejiwatundaka handji waze maya mumingoso.
eng_text: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Mba naua kuyifuchi yikuo, chatelalume umue mukanda uze uamana ukutuala kuli yoze mazanga kulilongesa, mba naua aprovas de fundus yize muyihasa kumukuasa akutuala amuaka uze utango akulilongesa chemyi.
eng_text: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Ku zuwo lize akutambula athu aze akuiza ku ifuci yeka kanazanga ku longuesa hanga ande sango kanawa.
eng_text: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Ny wate mapwa yoze anathumumo,nhikhakukilikicila muifuci ya ulambala cinalumbunukangwo ndo mukasoneka ngwe aminvungugwanhikuhana cihanda ca futo liami mucifuci muze nakathukilenhimuze nathuama.
eng_text: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Wufumbuko wa táxi wulyi nhi mulalyi wakutesa cekha nhi kulyita nhi cifuci nhi cifuci, mba nganyo nhi yikwo yalyifwa nhi feto yakwalumuka cindji nhi kulyita nhi cifuci nhi cifuci.
eng_text: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Naua muyifuchi yikuo muyifuchi, ngue Estados Unidos nhi Canada, imposto ya renda kaku yi kala muyifuchi nhi chihela chesue, ngue dando muyili tuchika achihela nhi chihela.
eng_text: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Ximbu controlo iya akwa kuya muifuci iya haze ili kafa lume ixiho handji ili imue formalidade ximbu muheta ha mavu je natal, controlo aduaneiro muihassa kupua imue ipikala.
eng_text: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Tala kanawanhiunanhingika ize muhasanhiuci kuhasa kuneha handji kumbata hanga wambulule cimwe Cumanhiwahiahisa.
eng_text: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Chuma chize chashi chakuputuka mingoso yakusoneka ya uenhi nhi kununga akutuala kumana jenhi um website ya blogue a uenhi uze anakalitesa nacho.
eng_text: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Muze iya kwiva upemanhiformatacaonhiedicao mu web, ha cingoloxi, mahassa kupita iyaiyenwe enwe Website.
eng_text: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Kulihana ximbu iya wenhi cili cimue cipema ilinga iya kulinga cinalisse, mba cixi wika iya kuhana.
eng_text: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Kutuama upue mukakulihana muze muchifuchi cha haze yinapu mutapu upema unahase kunhingika yimue ndako yina lituchika, unhingike naua atu aha uli longese mutapu ho, upue naua nhi shindakenyo ya umuenemuene anga ukapue nhi manyonga akuo.
eng_text: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Ndo mupua kuzuo kuze mutuamako matangua andji, cilumbo milimo iyesue iyakuhana utuamino nhi culia, ako kakufeta falanga.
eng_text: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Mue vikings ayo kakukuata jiya ja meya Russas anga ahete ku kalunga luiji mu laya nhi ku mar caspio. yi handa ya yuma yino ya jiya jino mahasa ku jendela. Tala mutapu ua kuli ulumba nacho ya kuheta yuma yize ikalu keshi kuhasa kupua nayo.
eng_text: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Canal iya Kalunga Luiji Mutoma iya Baltico iyananungu Oceano Arctico hali Kalunga Luiji Baltico, ha iya Citende Onega, Citende LadoganhiSao Petersburgo, mu undji weny muma luijinhiitende.
eng_text: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Lake Onega wenhi kanalicingui ku Volga, ize macinyonganguoandji ineza ku mar Caspio ku Russia.
eng_text: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Kupua nhi umuenemuene ngue muze muiheta marinas, yesue muikapua kanaua.Mutu kauanako naua yuma yikuo caroneiros de barcos kuenaku makalitesa amana jo.
eng_text: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Acize kanasse kanahasa kuanhisa nhi kuenda hanga ahasse kupua hakamuihi nhi athu aze akukusumuna iate zow aze anazanga ko handjika nhi aiyo, nhi kahia um luigi.
eng_text: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Fupa kuhandjika nhi athu angji. Nhi kupalika lia tangua essue kakanhinguika nhi mahassa ku kukulueza ize inapalika.
eng_text: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Cinatela kussakula kanawa kanawa wendelo we iyamwilo Frequent Flyer mumue alianca.
eng_text: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Cipwe mungunyonga ngwe te mucitela kupwa mukwa cizavu cakwa kuhumuka cindji nhi ndeke, ndo cikulumbumuke ngwo yawana yize wakutambula muyihasa kupwa yalyisa nhi yihela yize akupalyikila ngeji handji mikuhasa kupwa ashishika hakutwala kucizavu cize cakwa kuhumuka nhi ndeke jalyisa nhi akwo.
eng_text: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Mazuwonhiuthumino uneneunene wa ndeke ngue Emirates, Eithad Airway, Qtar AwaysnhiTurkish Airline, haanayamwanga cindji milimo yo mu Áfricanhikaakuhana kulivashana ku mambongue andji aulemu amungongo ya África, kufuta co capwa cakukathukila kuhiana uyhumino wamandeke wamambongue amu Europa.
eng_text: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Ndeke ja akwa Turquia ja kwenda wenhi 39 mu yifucha ya ku afrika kuchiza mwaka wa 2014.
eng_text: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Nhi unambe kuiya ku cifuci txiko ndo mutala cize iyuma inende hanga wiye ku Afrika, kuhanhisa nhi falanga mufeta ku ikatuka iko.
eng_text: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Khanda ivulama kuwezela kundando já kuwezela gize maaka kuita ngwo wezela ku kukupalikisa, kukukathukanhiminhaunhiikwokwo, hakuthuala haihela ya haze lia África.
eng_text: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: nhi unazange kwenda mu ifuci yeswe nhi ndeke hanga upalike ku hemisferio sul, kusakula ca ndeke ca yena mwene ca kupwa kukinda mumu hakuhona waze masakula jila yaco.
eng_text: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Ny imue alianca iyamwilu iyakufuka atatu mautangunukino akalunga luiji ku hemisferio kutho (ny ha Sky Team kexi kufetessanhiimue iya mautangunukino.
eng_text: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Ha cino, Star Alliance kunafuku iyessue kuhiana Pacifico Kutho Oriental, iya Santiego iya Chile hali Taiti,nguoili imue ndeke iya LATAM Oneworld.
eng_text: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Aindeke kuyapwila ngwe majila wawenewikha kha.nhimizanga kuthumbuka kalunga yoze anasanhika ngwo Passífico sulnhingenge ya civumbuko yaku América ya Kumbavu (tala muxi)
eng_text: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Mu muaka wa 1994, acize cihanda ca Arménia ca thungi a cako ca Naggorno karabkh ca ku Azerbaijão, yalikuika ymwe jita nhi a azeris.
eng_text: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Ny wkwaso wa Arménia yaathungako cifuci cikwo caha, aliozenhiamwe mbunga waze haanaseko handji haanalhungu cipwe mwe Arménia keshi kuisa ulemu.
eng_text: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Yambo ya akwa malyindjekela atwala halyi akwa kulemba Zambi, kuyishi nhi wulyivashane halyi akwa Aeménia hamwe nhi akwa Azerbaijão.
eng_text: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Distrito ya Canal (holandes: Grachtengordel) ye canal yafuma yamu centenario 17 yajinga distrito ya Binnestad Amsterdam.
eng_text: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Ku cihela essue kaku sanhikanguopatrimonio wa cilumbo ca ulemu uenhi wa ilinga nhi iximo ulemu wa yuma yenhi kali ikalo cindji ku cifuxi.
eng_text: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Ifuci ize itano anasanhinka ngwo (cinque terre) inalumbununa thuihunda thutano tua kungenge ya luiji Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, VernazanhiMonterroso, ize yathuama ku ihela ya Itália ize ya Ligúria.
eng_text: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Ayo kali akusonekeza ku mukanda akwa UNESCO wa hano hashi.
eng_text: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Hmashimbu a khama lya myaka, athu atungile kanawakanawa kwilu lya mazuwo yihela yize kuyishi nhi wupeme handji yikalu kunhina yinapu kutunga kusesa lya kalunga-lwiji.
eng_text: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Yuma iko alinga kuilinga cilumbo kushi muthu yoze mamuuanhissa.
eng_text: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Ihandjika iya francesnguoakuhandji mu Belgicanhimu Suica iyalissa cikehe cindjinhifrances akuhandjika mu Franca, cipue kanapu analifu cindji hanga apue uthu cindji amwive.
eng_text: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Kualula ca waze akuhanjika franceji mu Suiça nhi mu Bélgica, calihandununa.
eng_text: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Hacoco, akwa cifuci ca Belgas nhi Suiça alyi nhi lyimi lya Francesa kapwa kulomgesa Francês wamwenemwene kushikola, hanga akapwe nhi wunhingikiso wa kuyilyinga milalyi wa kwalula mulyimi lya Francês wamwenemwene.
eng_text: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Mayifuchi yikuo naua, acenar chili umue usendo uakusa “kanaua”.
eng_text: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Cikunguluila ca mavungu alicinga a yalikala manhonga a kualumuna mukanda wakukanjisa kulimbata.
eng_text: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Ce cimuikha uma ngueji britânico mu spanha, mahasa kupinda mu makhimba.
eng_text: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Malimi akehe akehe ja Africa nhi manhonga akuezela lusango mbunga esue the mapua nhi matata hakulihandjikisa.
eng_text: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Malime ene a ku organika, aze ane akuhasa ku handjika kuli atuesue ananhingika lime lietu.
eng_text: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Muze ginacapua hakukatuka akua mbongue, kanakamona kuma kuze kuako fambukila meia.
eng_text: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Mahassa kukola homa nhi mukwa kwendessa katalile kanawa kahia nhi manhissa meia.
eng_text: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Phuya muihasa kusasaminha cesuaco, ahliose ufuku ndo mumukekema. Keshika mucihasa kupwa undjililo wa sathandanhimuthu kazalile mahina cipwe mazalo waze maamuvumisa.
eng_text: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Nukanyamanhitumwe mu luiza ha kwendela mu mushitu.
eng_text: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Cipwe kuunendesa minhau mu kaci kamusengue wa mahumbu cipwe wa washi, mba muthwama imwe mifunda ikehenhiikolo yawashi, muze mundjila mu minhau mucipwa shimbu ize inatela hanga undjile cimuikhanhithumwe.
eng_text: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Ihwema iya matujila, handji nawa ihwema iyatujilamwilu, muihassa kukwata handji ma tujila ngue matuxitu.
eng_text: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Mwishi lia kanunu ka atu akwalula achambujolanga, mba anji akuli aya afwanga.
eng_text: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Andji te kanasse athunguoakalakalanhitujila, mba hali nawa umue upi hanga kutala iya tujila.
eng_text: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Athu atwama ku Noroega kakuhana giya ku imbongue ikulo, muhassa kuheta kaushi.
eng_text: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Ayino planaltos mashimbu esue yapua kusanhika ngue “vidde” yinalumbunuka ngue chihela chinene chize cha haze chakuhona mitondo chize tuishi kuhasa kualula.
eng_text: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Mu RogalandnhiAgder kali cindji cindji akussanika “hei”nguocinalumbunuka imue charneca ixi mitindo cindji cindji anafuku iya Heather.
eng_text: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Ma glaciares gishi kupema, ndo jakusunuka ha milundu, muihassa ku koka gia lia kupihisa iyuma.
eng_text: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Mbango ja cikuku ca umbu wa ciwe mujihasa kupuzuka welo miaji yajo muihasa kuthunguluka.
eng_text: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: kungo lya glaciares, mawe a meya anene akupulika nhi kakuholoka shimbu likwo matwumbuka nhi kujinga kusuku lya songo lyaco.
eng_text: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Cihela ca kukwacila wendelo kulyi akwa wungejiwatundaka yakupwa há mashimbu já Colinas kwakupwa mbunga andji há mashimbu a lushiho Indiano.
eng_text: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Mba naua, kali nhi kulituchika cha upeme uenhi encanto mashimbu ya luiza,mba naua mu unji ua estacoes ya milundu yize yinatambula mbundu jipema nhi kuhana naua yuma yikuo ngue anji esqui nhi snowboarding.
eng_text: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Yimwe yizavu yikehe yakwa kwendesa ndeke ndo musono kanasolola yinhingi ya wufe, mumu kanatepulula ndando yawenhi yakwa kufunda há mashimbu ano.
eng_text: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Yizavu ya akwa milyimo ya kuhumuka nhi ndeke kanacingiko Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa kundeke jineza ku´E.U.A. handji Canada, nhi Westjet.
eng_text: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Ha yuma yessue, cinatela kutulikila ku telefone nhi conpamia iya ndeke.
eng_text: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
